entities.summary: Matt Henderson is an American retired ice hockey winger. He played in six National Hockey League games with the Nashville Predators and Chicago Blackhawks between 1999 and 2002. The rest of his career, which lasted from 1998 to 2004, was mainly spent in the minor leagues.
